scripts.test: npm run clean:allure && npx playwright test
scripts.test:chrome: npm run clean:allure && npx playwright test --project=chromium
scripts.test:firefox: npm run clean:allure && npx playwright test --project=firefox
scripts.test:safari: npm run clean:allure && npx playwright test --project=webkit
scripts.test:edge: npm run clean:allure && npx playwright test --project=edge
scripts.test:smoke: npm run clean:allure && npx playwright test --grep @smoke
scripts.test:regression: npm run clean:allure && npx playwright test --grep @regression
scripts.test:headed: npm run clean:allure && npx playwright test --headed
scripts.allure:report: npm run allure:generate && npm run allure:open
